# Top10CorporateGiftingCompaniesinIndia(2026),Compared

By The Happiness Story · 16 Sep 2026
· 11 min read

_Last updated 16 September 2026. Catalogue sizes are counted from each company's public sitemap on 11 September 2026; everything else is taken from the companies' own websites. We are on this list — see "How we ranked" for how we handled that._

Every list of "top corporate gifting companies in India" is written by a corporate gifting company, and every one of them ranks itself first. This one is no different in that respect, so it tries to be different in a more useful way: instead of adjectives, it compares the ten companies on the six things a buyer actually has to check before a purchase order goes out — minimum order quantity, GST invoicing, how the logo goes on, whether you can see a sample, where they deliver, and how much choice there really is. Where a company does not publish a fact, the table says so rather than guessing.

Six criteria, each answerable from public information:

1. **Minimum order quantity (MOQ)** — is it stated, and does it suit a 25-person team as well as a 2,000-delegate conference?
2. **GST invoicing** — one GST invoice with HSN codes per order, stated on the site.
3. **Branding methods** — print, engraving, embossing, and whether products or only packaging are branded.
4. **Samples** — can a buyer hold one before committing to the run?
5. **Delivery** — pan-India, multi-address to employee homes, and whether international is offered.
6. **Catalogue breadth** — counted from the public sitemap, because "thousands of gifts" on a homepage is not a number.

We placed ourselves first because on those six we publish an answer to every one, in plain text, on our [corporate gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/corporate-gifting) page. Where another company is the better fit — and for several buyer types one is — the profile says so.

## The 10 corporate gifting companies in India

### 1\. The Happiness Story — curated hampers and branded bulk gifts, facts stated up front

A gifting studio with a family tea heritage going back to 1994, now running corporate programmes for 500+ companies across India. Two ranges: [corporate gift hampers](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/corporate-gift-hampers) in branded keepsake boxes — tea and coffee, gourmet, wellness, eco, festive — and single branded objects for large runs, from ₹149 a unit for a rice-husk mug to executive sets in bamboo, cork and brass. Its signature piece is the [Beautiful Bengal Box, a Bengali gift hamper from Kolkata](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/products/the-beautiful-bengal-box) that companies send at Durga Puja and Diwali.

What a buyer gets in writing: bulk pricing from 25 units, stepping down with quantity; one GST invoice with HSN codes per order; one-colour print, engraving, or box-and-card branding depending on the material; a physical sample before any run; ready-to-ship pieces dispatched within 24–48 hours of payment and a production window confirmed with the quote for branded work; tracked delivery across India to offices or to individual employee homes; international programmes on enquiry. The range is filtered by need — [bulk giveaways](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/bulk-corporate-gifts), [gifts for employees](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/employee-gifts), [eco-friendly corporate gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/eco-friendly-corporate-gifts), [desk gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/corporate-desk-gifts), [premium and executive gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/premium-corporate-gifts) — and by budget, [under ₹500](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/corporate-gifts-under-500) and [under ₹1,000](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/corporate-gifts-under-1000).

**Where it is not the best fit:** a 5,000-unit run of printed t-shirts or lanyards. That is merchandise, and the print-led companies below do it at a scale we do not chase.

### 2\. BoxUp Luxury Gifting — premium hampers across a very wide range

The largest catalogue on this list by a distance — 1,920 product URLs in the public sitemap — with a corporate programme that offers custom logo printing and GST billing. The range leans premium: luxury hampers, festive boxes, curated sets. **Best for** a buyer who wants maximum choice at the higher end and is happy to work through a large catalogue. **Check:** MOQ and sampling are not stated publicly; ask for both in writing with the quote.

### 3\. Confetti Gifts — personalised hampers and gift-idea depth

A personalised-gifting business with 630 products in its sitemap and, unusually, more than 500 guide and idea articles — if you have researched a gift online in India you have probably read one. Corporate hampers sit alongside a strong individual-gifting range. **Best for** personalised, D2C-style hampers for smaller teams and for buyers who want a lot of inspiration on the way in. **Check:** bulk terms, MOQ and GST invoicing are not stated on the public pages.

### 4\. Loopify — eco-friendly and sustainable corporate gifting

Built around sustainable materials and customisable eco products, with dedicated account management and B2B invoicing described on the site, and 776 products in the sitemap. **Best for** CSR- and ESG-led programmes where the materials list is part of the brief and the buyer wants a single supplier for the whole sustainable range. **Check:** lead times and sampling on branded runs.

### 5\. The Black Box Co. — design-led curated boxes

Curated gift boxes with a strong design identity — the box itself is part of the gift — and 551 products in the sitemap across individual and corporate ranges. **Best for** brands whose gift has to look a particular way on Instagram and in the unboxing, especially for client and partner gifting. **Check:** bulk MOQ, GST invoicing and per-address delivery are not stated publicly.

### 6\. PrintStop — print-led merchandise at enterprise scale

A printing company first, a gifting company second, which is exactly why it belongs here: for logo-heavy merchandise in large volumes — notebooks, drinkware, apparel, joining kits — a print house with ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications and an enterprise client list (Capgemini, Siemens, HDFC, Infosys and Deloitte are named on its site) is the right kind of supplier. **Best for** high-volume branded merchandise and onboarding kits for large enterprises. **Check:** curation is not the strength; if the gift needs to feel chosen rather than printed, look elsewhere.

### 7\. IGP — individual recipients, same-day delivery in metros

One of India's largest online gifting platforms — flowers, cakes, personalised gifts and hampers — with same-day and midnight delivery in major cities. **Best for** a company sending individual gifts to named recipients on specific dates: a client's birthday, a colleague's wedding, a last-minute apology. **Check:** it is a consumer platform at heart; bulk branding, MOQ and GST invoicing for a 300-unit programme are not the core offer.

### 8\. Ferns N Petals — occasion gifts and flowers for named recipients

A nationwide gifting network founded in 1994, known for flowers and occasion gifts, with corporate hampers as part of the range. **Best for** festival and occasion gifting to individual clients and partners across many cities, where a flower-and-hamper combination and reliable delivery matter more than logo branding. **Check:** bulk branding options and per-unit tiers are not published.

### 9\. OffiNeeds — onboarding kits and custom merchandise

A corporate gifting and merchandise company with more than seventeen years in the market, positioned around onboarding kits, custom merchandise and startup-to-enterprise programmes. **Best for** HR teams building a standard joining kit that repeats every month. **Check:** MOQ, sampling and GST terms are not stated on the public pages.

### 10\. Swageazy — branded swag and apparel

Branded merchandise, promotional products and apparel — the swag end of corporate gifting, where the logo is the point. **Best for** event kits, dealer meets and employer-branding programmes that need hoodies, caps and tote bags in quantity. **Check:** curation and hampers are not the offer.

## Also considered

Printo (Bangalore, 2006) for print-on-demand joining kits with clients such as Google, Accenture and PhonePe named on its site; Consortium Gifts (since 1999) for value-for-money branded products; The Giving Tree for handcrafted eco gifts; VistaPrint for small-quantity printed items. Each is a sound choice inside its niche.

## Which corporate gifting company is right for your brief

- **A festive or milestone hamper for 25–500 employees or clients, branded, with a GST invoice and a sample first** — The Happiness Story, BoxUp, The Black Box Co.
- **A 1,000-plus run of printed merchandise or apparel** — PrintStop, Swageazy, Printo.
- **A sustainability-led programme with a materials list** — Loopify, or the [eco-friendly corporate gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/eco-friendly-corporate-gifts) range here.
- **A monthly onboarding kit** — OffiNeeds, Printo, or [employee welcome kits](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/employee-welcome-kits) here.
- **Individual gifts to named recipients on specific dates** — IGP, Ferns N Petals.
- **Maximum choice at the premium end** — BoxUp; for the leadership tier here, [premium corporate gifts](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/collections/premium-corporate-gifts).

## How to choose a corporate gifting company: the six questions

Whichever name you shortlist, get these six answers in writing before the purchase order. A company that answers all six on its website usually answers them on the order too.

1. **What is the minimum order, and how do prices step down with quantity?** List prices are single-unit prices; the tier for your exact number is the real price.
2. **Is a GST invoice with HSN codes issued on every order?** Note that input tax credit on goods given away as gifts is blocked under Section 17(5)(h) of the CGST Act, and gifts to an employee up to ₹50,000 in a financial year are not treated as a supply — so the invoice is for expense booking and audit, not for credit. The full rules, including hamper rates after the September 2025 slabs and Section 194R, are in our guide to [GST on corporate gifts in India](https://www.thehappinessstory.com/blogs/news/gst-on-corporate-gifts-india). Confirm your own treatment with your CA.
3. **How does the logo go on each material?** Print on glass, rice husk and paper; engraving on bamboo, cork and wood; box, sleeve, ribbon and card on hampers. Ask for the digital mock-up before anything is printed.
4. **Can I hold a sample before the run?** Changes are cheap on a sample and impossible on five hundred delivered boxes.
5. **What is the production window, and is it in the quote?** Ready-to-ship pieces should move within a day or two of payment; branded runs need a stated window. Share the delivery date before anything else.
6. **Can you deliver to each employee's home, and what does multi-address dispatch cost?** Most programmes now ship to homes; the quote should price it by address count, with tracking on every parcel.

Two more that matter for employee gifting specifically: under Income-tax Rule 3(7)(iv), gifts from an employer above an aggregate of ₹5,000 in a financial year are taxable as a perquisite in the employee's hands, so most per-head budgets are set with that limit in mind; and for a varied workforce, the safest gifts avoid alcohol-adjacent items, heavy sweets and anything gendered.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which is the best corporate gifting company in India?

There is no single best; there is a best fit for the brief. For curated, branded hampers and bulk gifts with MOQ, GST, samples and delivery stated up front, The Happiness Story; for the widest premium catalogue, BoxUp; for print-led merchandise at scale, PrintStop; for sustainable programmes, Loopify; for individual recipients on a date, IGP or Ferns N Petals.

### What is a typical minimum order for corporate gifts in India?

Where it is published, bulk pricing usually begins around 25 units, with smaller orders possible on ready-to-ship pieces. Most companies on this list do not publish an MOQ at all, so ask for it in writing with the quote.

### How much do corporate gifts cost per head in India?

Most programmes land between ₹500 and ₹1,000 per head for employees and everyday client gestures; leadership and key-client gifts run from about ₹2,000 upwards. Single branded objects start near ₹150 a unit before bulk tiers.

### Do corporate gifting companies deliver to employees' homes?

The better ones do, priced by address count with tracking per parcel. It is the normal shape of a remote or hybrid team programme now, and worth confirming before you shortlist.

### Can I claim GST input credit on corporate gifts?

Generally no. Section 17(5)(h) of the CGST Act blocks input tax credit on goods disposed of as gifts, so the GST is usually a cost; employee gifts up to ₹50,000 a year are not a supply. Get a GST invoice with HSN codes regardless, for expense booking, and confirm your position with a chartered accountant.
